big: Nifty Bank is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Bank track?
The Nifty Bank Index comprises of the most liquid and large Indian Banking stocks. It holds 14 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.

q: The Nifty Bank P/E is 12.95 and the Nifty 50 P/E is 19.36. How do they compare?
why: 12.95 is below 19.36, so this reverses the facts.
12.95 is below the Nifty 50's 19.36, as stated.
The two figures differ, so they are not equal.
A ratio like P/E can be compared across indices.

q: Its 5-year return is +7.9% a year. What should an RM say?
opts: It will repeat each year again
It is guaranteed to come back
It carries no risk at all
why: No repeat of any past return can be promised.
Nothing is guaranteed in a market index.
Equity indices carry risk of loss in any year.
Past returns do not predict future returns.

pts: Nifty Bank: HDFC Bank leads at 18.61%; top 10 add to 87.5%.
Rebalanced semi-annually. Past returns do not predict the future.
